manufactureInstallation.sealJoint: Tooled exterior perimeter sealant over hidden closed-cell backer rod. 10.6 x 7.2 mm nominal visible bead envelope; four corner tool pools. Hand-tooled sub-mm waviness is geometry.
manufactureInstallation.headDripCap: 0.8 mm folded aluminum head flashing, 45 mm rear leg, 62 mm projection, 18 mm face, 6 mm hem, end dams, five mechanical fasteners and isolation washers.
manufactureInstallation.weepHoods: Two removable PP hoods aligned with existing sill weep locations. Open undersides remain openings; residue geometry is shallow and causally restricted to outlet paths.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Seal joint sits just outside the existing 1.800 m frame; backer rod is behind sealant. Head flashing is above the sealant/frame. Weep hoods mount to the exterior sill face rather than replacing existing weep cavities.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Exterior is +Z; gravity -Y. Future lighting assumes coherent Japanese midsummer sun plus sky fill/reflection; no highlight is baked.
manufactureInstallation.agingCausality: Only small mineral residue at weep outlets is authored. No random rust, algae or full-wall grime. Sealant chalking and corner dirt remain material-level future work.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Sealant bead, backer rod, flashing folds, end dams, fasteners, hoods and residue thickness are geometry. Fine tooling, foam pore, extrusion brush, PP grain and mineral roughness are texture proxies.
